target_customer: Institutional investors (claims $70B+ client AUM) and large consulting firms
problem: Investors and consultants struggle to mine unstructured sources such as podcasts for market intelligence.
business_model: B2B SaaS/data product with web platform, REST API, MCP server and data warehouse feed (pricing not public)

founders.name: Rohan Sharma
previous_startups: Kosmos (data integrations SaaS for wealth managers, bootstrapped and exited)

technical_complexity.rationale: Indexing 2M+ curated transcripts with semantic search, tagging and citations is standard modern LLM/retrieval engineering at scale for a 4-person team.

defensibility.rationale: Curated, tagged transcript index could build data advantage, but sources show no exclusive data; similar tools are easy to build.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Too early; no incumbent action found.

market_need_then: Company claims paying use by investors with $70B+ AUM and 2 of the 3 top consulting firms (self-reported, unverified).
outcome_analysis: Serafis is an active Summer 2025 YC company, so there is no outcome yet. Founder Rohan Sharma's background at Ribbit Capital gives investor-domain access, and the company claims investor and consulting customers, but only an unverified $500K pre-seed from an aggregator is known and nothing independently shows traction.
notes: $500K pre-seed from one aggregator, unconfirmed (may be YC's standard deal). Customer claims self-reported. YC page says product started with podcasts. Competition not evidenced.
